libs.note: BH-8739. The fewest children a decompose spec files. bin/run-decompose.sh merges every proposed slice that has no reason to stand alone (file overlap, the build-execute context ceiling, or a real merge order) and asks a person on the parent before it files more than SLICE_CONFIRM_OVER children. Read per project with lib_env_apply slice-gate <project> (sr_knob), so a row lib.slice-gate.<project>.<env lowercased> wins for that project.

knobs.note: 1 (the default): bin/run-decompose.sh coalesces the spec and asks before a split above SLICE_CONFIRM_OVER. 0: the decomposer files the spec as the model wrote it, as before BH-8739.

The context a child costs per product line it plans (est_lines). est_lines x this, summed over a child, is compared with the build-execute ceiling: past it, the next slice starts a new child (reason context-ceiling). 400 puts a 700-line child at about 280K, under the 500K ceiling.

Above this many children (the larger of the size gate's SIZE_SLICES_EXPECTED and the merged spec), the decomposer posts the proposed grouping on the parent and files nothing until a person replies (HUMAN-STEP-DONE: on an issues board, any reply by another author on an in-app board).
Used only when catalog/context-budgets.json (lane build-execute, ceiling_tokens) cannot be read. Equal to that row today. Read by sr_ceiling_tokens.
